## My Business

We have been in the bag manufacturing and wholesale business since 1982. For more than 40 years, we have been the experts and successfully led the BAGS & LUGGAGE industry.

We also have our retail showroom with a multi-brand factory outlet store in Ulhasnagar with the name "Bag Factory", where we deal in all types of branded bags like American Tourister, Safari, VIP, Aristocrat, Skybags, Wildcraft, etc. We have an authorised dealership with 16+ big brands.

Our USP is to customise bags according to the client's specifications with an MOQ. We also work for Schools, Gyms, Coaching Institutes, NGOs, Corporate GIFTING, Government tenders, OEM, and Export orders.

### Ideal Referral

1) School/Coaching Classes Backpacks MOQ 60pcs.

2) Gym Owner's who need custom made bags in bulk for give away freebies.

3) Marketing Executive Backpacks in Bulk with logo branding for FMCG, Pharma, IT Companies

4) Custom made bags for Diwali Gifting

5) Tours & Travels firms who give promotional freebies to their clients with there company logo print in bulk.

5) Retail/ Wholesale Bag Shops (PAN India.)

6) Buyer/ Importer of All types of bags from African and Gulf Countries.

### Top Problem Solved

Removed 130pcs a Company Logo Print of a Tech Company from a branded American Tourister Duffle Bag, MRP was around Rs.2000/- very neatly done, and saved the client's hard earned money.

### My Ideal Referral Partner

Stationery Suppliers, Uniform Manufacturers, Corporate Gifters, Marketing Companies, Printer, Event Managers, HR/ Admins/ Purchase head of any company with a staff of more than 50 people.

### Top Product

Laptop Bag, School Bag, Gym Bag, Office Bag, Travel Bag, Duffle Bag, Sling Bag, Trekking Bag, Jute Bag, Trolley Bag etc.

### My Favourite BNI Story

I have converted my "Competitor into Collaborator" and doing business together.
